preserves: 487c3ad, retained as an INTERMEDIATE AUDIT COMMIT. Its inferential numbers are withdrawn; its descriptive means and structural findings stand.

THE_DEFECT_VERIFIED.the_claim: with two clusters a Holm-adjusted p of .0081 cannot be a valid date-block result
THE_DEFECT_VERIFIED.arithmetic: An exact cluster-level sign-flip test with k clusters has 2^k assignments, so the smallest attainable two-sided p is 2/2^k. For k=2 that is 0.5000. The reported .0081 is 62 times smaller than the test can produce.
THE_DEFECT_VERIFIED.root_cause: _p_from_interval applied a normal approximation to a bootstrap whose resample space holds three distinct means. The z-statistic it produced carried the degrees of freedom of 30 GAMES, not of 2 CLUSTERS. The independence assumption was correctly avoided in the interval and then reintroduced in the p-value.

AMENDMENT_1_SUPPRESSION.rule: k >= log2(2/alpha), DERIVED from the test and not chosen. At alpha=.05 that is SIX clusters.
AMENDMENT_1_SUPPRESSION.no_new_threshold: the 500-game / 60-slate-date gate remains the binding one; this rule only decides whether an inferential verdict may be PRINTED

raw_means_retained.note: descriptive only; no inference attaches to either

AMENDMENT_1_SUPPRESSION.a_trap_this_exposed: NOT_EVALUABLE is a truthy string, so bool() would have read a suppressed verdict as a PASS. The gate now compares to True explicitly, and a fixture drives a suppressed comparison at it to prove the difference.

AMENDMENT_2_CHRONOLOGY.accepted: prior_last_game_date=2026-08-18 does not prove safety against a cutoff of 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z. That cutoff is 17:00 Pacific on August 18, and West Coast games dated the 18th were still in progress.

RESULT_ON_THE_REAL_COHORT.pool_leak_audit: PREQUENTIAL_CLEAN 30/30 — no same-slate or target-game result in any prior
RESULT_ON_THE_REAL_COHORT.meaning: The repository stores no result-finalization timestamps at all. The prior's chronological safety is therefore UNPROVEN, not proven and not disproven. The cohort audit now FAILS on this, and zero_integrity_failures joins the blocking list where it previously read clean on a calendar-date check that could not see the problem.

AMENDMENT_3_ARM_IDENTITY.THE_FINDING: No evaluation_arm_id, input_policy_id or CAP-substitution policy existed anywhere before today. The registry carried free-text experiment_arm labels that DIFFER between the two dates for the same conceptual arm — 08-19 recorded V1_SERIES_SLATE_PRICE_BLOCKED, 08-21 recorded V1_WEB_SCHEDULE_NO_STARTERS_NO_PRICES. Those describe each day's acquisition circumstances, not a frozen policy. The two 08-19 arms were generated 26 minutes apart the same morning with no prior registration.
AMENDMENT_3_ARM_IDENTITY.the_only_candidate_prereg: 2026-08-18_V14_STARTER_PREREG.json predates the cohort but registers a V14 estimator with its own feature set, not these V13 input policies
AMENDMENT_3_ARM_IDENTITY.consequence: The 30-game comparison is NOT prospective challenger evidence and must not be cited as such. The registered identities are prospective from 2026-08-23 forward. Prospectivity is derived from two instants; no field an author can set asserts it, and a fixture proves a record claiming prospectivity is overridden.

AMENDMENT_4_ESTIMABILITY_IS_NOT_ACCEPTAN.accepted: the Hessian rule is a numerical estimability guard only
AMENDMENT_4_ESTIMABILITY_IS_NOT_ACCEPTAN.now: calibration_estimability and calibration_acceptable are separate fields with separate reasons. An UNDEFINED calibration is explicitly NOT acceptable — defaulting it would let the least measurable arm clear the strictest condition.
